data.name: Clemente
data.long_meaning: The name Clemente is derived from the Greek word 'klementos', meaning 'merciful' or 'mild'. It was a popular name among the early Christians and was given to those who showed kindness and gentleness to others. In the Bible, Saint Clement is mentioned as one of the seven deacons appointed by the apostles to help the poor and needy in the early Christian community. He is also known as the first pope, having been elected to the position around AD 80.
